description: This Java source file defines the MidiDispatcher class which extends MidiReceiver. It manages a list of MidiReceiver objects, dispatches MIDI messages to them, and manages their connections via a MidiSender object. The class also provides methods to retrieve the number of receivers, the sender, and handles dispatching and flushing MIDI data.
external_methods: MidiReceiver.send(byte[] msg, int offset, int count, long timestamp)

classes.name: MidiDispatcher
classes.description: A utility class that dispatches MIDI data to a list of MidiReceiver objects. It manages receivers and handles MIDI message dissemination.

methods.name: getReceiverCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MidiReceiver objects currently managed by this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Provides a MidiSender object used to connect or disconnect MidiReceivers.

methods.name: onSend
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.onSend. Dispatches the MIDI message to all receivers, removing any that throw an IOException.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Overrides MidiReceiver.flush. Calls flush on all managed receivers.
